ValidationRule.description: This validation rule ensure that the format of the BIC is correctly captured by User, and follow the finnish format. This rule can be bypassed by a User by checking the field 'BypassVR' on its account.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && ISPICKVAL( ER_BUPicklist__c, 'FI') && NOT(LEN(ER_BIC__c) = 0) && LEN(ER_BIC__c) <> 8 && LEN(ER_BIC__c) <> 11
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The format of the BIC must be 8 or 11 characters long
